title: Sonic Healthcare Limited - proposed acquisition of pathology businesses of Healthscope Limited in Queensland and Western Australia

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.

ACCC requested further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline suspended. Former proposed decision date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 12 July 2012 delayed pending receipt of information requested.
ACCC received submissions from the merger parties following ACCC's request for information on 3 July 2012. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.

ACCC requested further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline suspended. Former proposed decision date of 30 August 2012 delayed pending receipt of information from the parties. ACCC will announce a new proposed decision date in due course.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Sonic announced that it no longer proposes to acquire Healthscope's pathology businesses in New South Wales and the ACT.
ACCC announced it would oppose the proposed acquisition in Queensland but would not oppose the proposed acquisition in Western Australia.

body_sections.Summary: Sonic Healthcare Limited proposed to acquire the pathology businesses of Healthscope Limited in the states of Queensland and Western Australia. On 11 October 2012, the ACCC announced that it would oppose the proposed acquisition in Queensland but would  not oppose the proposed acquisition in Western Australia. Reasons for the ACCC's decision in relation to the proposed acquisition are provided in the Public Competition Assessment.
